summary: EUDA Health Holdings filed a Form 6-K on August 26, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing that its subsidiary, Melana International Pte. Ltd., won the SME100 Awards 2026 Singapore. The award, organized by Business Media International and audited by Baker Tilly Singapore, recognizes high-performing SMEs based on revenue growth and qualitative factors. Melana, founded in 2000, manages 31 properties across Singapore. This is a routine corporate announcement with no special-situation implications, no deal terms, and no strategic or financial event warranting classification.
